title: Quantum Chaos and Quantum Information: Interactions and Implications
summary: The notion of Shannon entropy is crucial for the theory of classical information. In quantum information theory, an analogous key role is played by the von Neumann entropy: quantum information processing is closely related to entropy dynamics. This reveals a direct link with the theory of quantum chaotic systems, which can be characterized by a positive entropy production. Furthermore, noise, which inevitably affects any quantum system, can be modeled by a random quantum operation or by coupling to an environment in a generic chaotic state.
